speaker: Doctor
text: That is a good start. To better understand the cause of your pain and swelling, can you tell me if you have noticed any morning stiffness that lasts longer than 30 minutes?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient reports increasing pain and swelling of the left knee over 2 months. Describes the pain as severe enough to awaken him from sleep on several occasions. States he tried taking ibuprofen with no relief. No family or personal history of significant illnesses.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (JIA) or early onset Rheumatoid Arthritis. Given the age (24, often counted in adult JIA or early onset RA), male gender, insidious onset over 2 months, pain severe enough to wake from sleep, swelling, and lack of response to NSAIDs, along with the absence of trauma, an inflammatory etiology is most likely. I will now request specific blood work and imaging to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes.

REQUEST TEST: ESR, CRP, Rheumatoid Factor (RF), Anti-CCP, and ANA.
REQUEST IMAGES: Left_Knee_XRay_ap_and_lateral.
